Gegeny Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Gégény, Hungary

Demolished. One of two Jewish cemeteries that appear to have existed in Gégény, documented from an 1870 cadastral map before being destroyed at an unrecorded time. Jews had settled in Gégény by the early 19th century, numbering 31 in 1828 and 111 by 1911; the community built a synagogue on Hunyadi Street, likely before 1925, having previously used a private house for prayer. From 1941, young men were sent for forced labor; in spring 1944, the entire community was transported to the Kisvárda Ghetto and then to Auschwitz on May 25.
